title: Univé builds an AI-ready workforce
summary: See how Univé built an AI-ready workforce with ChatGPT Enterprise by combining leadership, responsible governance, and employee-led innovation to transform work at scale.
body: See how Univé built an AI-ready workforce with ChatGPT Enterprise by combining leadership, responsible governance, and employee-led innovation to transform work at scale.
summaryZh: OpenAI发布了保险机构Univé部署ChatGPT Enterprise的企业应用案例。Univé通过管理层引导、负责任的AI治理以及员工主导的创新，推动全公司范围内的业务流程转型。该案例展示了企业在大规模部署AI工具时培育员工协同能力的实践路径。

aiReview.reasonZh: Univé通过部署ChatGPT Enterprise并结合负责任治理，打造具备AI协同能力的工作团队。
